topic: n8n Governance Kit 2026: One-Click Deploy and Operate n8n with Claude Code

key_points: Primary source: one-click n8n deploy into the user's OWN Railway account (free or ~$5 plan) plus a governance kit to operate it with Claude Code (Codex later)
Two-part architecture: control-plane (operator runs to provision a client) + client-kit (what the end user receives in their provisioned n8n environment)

client-kit ships .mcp.json (native n8n MCP + n8n-api, zero-secret via env vars), .claude/ (6 n8n skills + tech-search, settings, commands, hooks), knowledge/ (sanitized KB), rules/ (n8n-governance), memory/ (18 empirical golden rules)

Governance rules: @n8n-ops is the ONLY sanctioned operator for production mutations; native-first MCP priority; mandatory backup (snapshot->commit->mutate) before any mutation; naming convention [Category] Name; mandatory Error Trigger workflow on every production-activated workflow; automatic audit log of all MCP n8n_* calls
Railway account token is never persisted (regression test asserts it never reaches the database); provision_requests stores only email, project name, user agent with 30-day retention

n8n community edition is under the Sustainable Use License (fair-code, NOT open source) — provisioner creates instance in client's own account for internal business use, which the license permits; reselling n8n as hosted service is not permitted
The kit is a starting point, not a managed dependency — no auto-update, no remote service dependency
